about: The authority file for parties: one node per person, organisation, agency, outlet, channel or platform, whatever string a source or a row uses for it. Kept by the ontologist (ontologist@php.newsroom). An id from data/actors.json is reused unchanged, so the actor pages and this file name the same node. 'aliases' are the exact publisher strings in data/sources.json; the build refuses a publisher that resolves to no entity. Kinds and verbs are defined in data/ontology.json.
